name: Heavy-duty gas turbines (H and J class)
aliases: Heavy-duty gas turbines (H and J class)
principle: Large frame gas turbines compress air, burn natural gas at firing temperatures above 1,400 °C and expand the gas through a turbine that drives the compressor and a generator. H- and J-class machines are the most efficient frames: GE Vernova's 7HA.03 is rated 430 MW net in 60 Hz service and Mitsubishi's M701J/JAC series exceeds 64% combined-cycle efficiency on a lower-heating-value basis.
